description: Any web page as clean, LLM-ready markdown, text or html. This is a PAID x402 call: $0.01 USDC on Base at GET /api/scrape. This tool returns the payment resource to call; it does not fetch the page. Params: url (absolute http/https URL, required); format (markdown | text | html, default markdown); max_chars (integer, default 40000, max 120000).

url.description: Absolute http/https URL to fetch. Required.

name: scrape_url
